classificationRules.compatibility: Unicode U+F900–U+FAFF or existing compatibility note riskTypes includes compatibility-ideograph
classificationRules.variant: existing repository metadata/compatibility wording explicitly says 異体字 or variant
classificationRules.old_to_modern: verified metadata modern target matches dict and sourceNote explicitly describes old/new-form correspondence
classificationRules.unresolved: repository evidence is insufficient or data-quality conflicts exist
classificationRules.seoCandidate: non-identity/non-unresolved classification + no issues + verified matching metadata + at least two standalone repository signals; publication still requires actual search demand
